headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advises TKMS on joint venture with CFF Fluid Control
sum: TKMS ATLAS ELEKTRONIK GmbH has entered into a Joint Venture agreement with CFF Fluid Control Limited to establish TKMS CFF Defence Systems Private Limited in India. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised TKMS on this joint venture.
detail: TKMS ATLAS ELEKTRONIK GmbH has entered into a Joint Venture agreement with CFF Fluid Control Limited to establish TKMS CFF Defence Systems Private Limited in India. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised TKMS on this joint venture. The transaction team was led by Alina Arora (Partner) and Parth Singh (Partner), and comprised Anubhav Singh (Associate) and Priyanjali Malik (Associate). The intellectual property team comprised Dev Robinson (Partner), J.V.
